issues.description: image.tobytes() with declared format='RGB' silently corrupts non-RGB PIL images returned by the model
issues.detail: PIL opens PNGs from Gemini in whatever mode the file uses (RGBA, P, L). Calling tobytes() without converting while declaring format='RGB' produces a buffer of the wrong size and layout for downstream consumers. Fix: image.convert('RGB').tobytes() before pushing the frame.

issues.description: Monkey-patching genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE at import time mutates a third-party private global
issues.detail: The patch reaches into a private underscore-prefixed attribute of google-genai and mutates it at module import, affecting every consumer of genai in the process. The author labeled it a 'temporary hack' yet shipped it. File upstream, pin the version, push to client construction time, or use a supported API.

issues.description: Silent default-model change from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash buried in a feature PR
issues.detail: Flipping the default changes pricing, latency, and thinking-budget defaults for every existing caller who relied on the prior default. It is mentioned in CHANGELOG but complected with an unrelated image-generation feature. Split into its own commit so users can reason about the default independently.

issues.description: Image-model detection via substring 'image' in model name is a fragile capability check
issues.detail: Branching on `"image" in self._model_name` (and the nearby startswith for thinking) encodes capability facts in name strings. Future models like gemini-X-image-understanding will silently mis-route. Replace with a small data table or capability registry keyed by model id returning explicit flags.

issues.description: No error handling or size bound on inline image bytes before Image.open and PIL decoding
issues.detail: part.inline_data.data is read unconditionally into BytesIO and PIL. Malformed bytes raise UnidentifiedImageError and kill the context-processing loop; oversized payloads risk OOM despite the 5MB buffer bump. Wrap in try/except, log and continue, and validate size/dimensions before decoding.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this PR needs work before merge. Two real bugs ship with the feature: a self-described 'temporary hack' that monkey-patches a private google-genai attribute at import time, and an image.tobytes() path that declares RGB while accepting whatever mode PIL decoded. The default-model bump is an unrelated behavior change smuggled into a feature PR and should be split. Capability dispatch via substring matches on model names is fragile, and the inline-image path has no error handling or size bounds. Fixes are small but the contracts must be made explicit.
